title: Localization and thinning laws say where subjects are and what they get

statements.text: Two kinds of law are needed: a localization law saying when local subjects exist, and a thinning law saying which thinned-out aspects of the experience in their region they inherit, those that realize the information structures neuroscience ties to experience. Which conditions hold is an empirical question.

sources.quote: it says that we need a law determining that local subjects exist and only exist when certain precise conditions obtain
This is an empirical question, to be settled by our best theory concerning the physical correlates of local consciousness.
